title: narcissus assoanus var. palearensis
intro: Narcissus assoanus var. palearensis, commonly known as the Pale Narcissus or Wild Daffodil, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, depression, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus assoanus var. palearensis include its ability to act as a sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galanthamine, lycorine, and narciclasine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
